name: Francis Dashwood
original_name: フランシス・ダッシュウッド
source:
A debt collector and corpse dealer who works under Count Sandwich and the Hell-Fire Club.

"...is a skeezy debt collector with a heart of gold, a tortured past, nowhere to run, and nothing left to lose. Plus he has green skin. That's pretty special. And dude, check out those cowboy chaps!"

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
